name: io.github.benmcalillycreative/x402-trust-board
title: Settle Watch
description: Check an x402 or MPP endpoint before your agent pays it: ok, caution or avoid, with reasons.

tools.name: check_payment
tools.description: Before paying an agent-payable API (x402, MPP or L402), check whether it is safe: does it answer reliably, do its payment terms match its listing (no switched or burn wallets, no overcharges), and is the address it asks you to pay one the seller has proven is theirs. Returns verdict ok | caution | avoid | unknown with reasons. Pass the payTo address from the 402 response when you have it.

url.description: The full https:// URL you are about to pay

payTo.description: Optional: the address its 402 response asks you to pay (for L402, the payee node key from the invoice)

tools.name: check_listing
tools.description: For sellers: check whether an x402 endpoint is listed in Coinbase's Bazaar and, if not, why. Runs Coinbase's public validator (the indexer's own checks), looks the payout address up in Coinbase's merchant list, and adds the Settle Watch's 30-day availability against Coinbase's 99% bar for featured listings. Returns findings with a fix for each.

url.description: The full https:// URL of your paid endpoint

method.description: HTTP method of the route (default GET)
